Welcome to biomAid! This package has been specifically built to provide
biometricians with flexible functions for interpreting and further modelling of
results from complex linear mixed models fitted with software such as
**ASReml-R V4**. Watch this space, there are a lot more functions coming.

Every analysis function is paired with a `ggplot2` visualisation, and each pair
has a vignette working through the mathematics and a set of examples.

## Installation

```r
# From GitHub (requires remotes or pak)
pak::pkg_install("DrJ001/biomAid")

# or
remotes::install_github("DrJ001/biomAid")
```

> **Note:** The core modelling functions require an
> [ASReml-R V4](https://vsni.co.uk/software/asreml-r/) licence.
> `simTrialData()` and all `plot_*()` functions are fully standalone.

## Vignettes

| Vignette | Functions | Description |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| [Wald Tests on Fixed-Effect Contrasts](waldTest.html) | `waldTest()`, `plot_waldTest()` | Mathematical framework and worked examples for Wald and F-tests on linear contrasts |
| [Multivariate Random Regression](randomRegress.html) | `randomRegress()`, `plot_randomRegress()` | Conditioning schemes, baseline/adjusted decomposition and all plot types, worked through on multi-treatment MET data |
| [Multivariate Fixed-Effects Regression](fixedRegress.html) | `fixedRegress()`, `plot_fixedRegress()` | OLS conditioning schemes, baseline/adjusted index decomposition and plot types |
| [Extracting and Padding Field Trial Layouts](padTrial.html) | `padTrial()`, `plot_padTrial()` | Guard-row removal, missing-plot padding and Before/After visualisation |
| [Multiple Comparison Criteria](compare.html) | `compare()`, `plot_compare()` | HSD, LSD and Bonferroni criteria, by-group comparisons and all four plot types |
| [BLUP Accuracy in Multi-Environment Trials](accuracy.html) | `accuracy()`, `plot_accuracy()` | Mrode accuracy and Cullis H², supported random structures and all six plot types |
| [Simulating Multi-Environment Trials](simTrialData.html) | `simTrialData()`, `plot_simTrialData()` | Mathematical framework, balanced/unbalanced/split-plot designs and all four plot types |
| [Factor Analytic Variance Structures](faSummary.html) | `faSummary()`, `plot_faSummary()` | The FA decomposition itself: rotation, specific variances, variance accounted for, and all five plot types |
| [Factor Analytic Selection Tools: FAST and iClass](fastIC.html) | `fastIC()`, `plot_fastIC()` | FAST global metrics, iClass interaction classes and all six plot types, built on the decomposition above |
